headline: The streamers are fighting over Halloween
summary: TIFF 2026 revealed new horror series from multiple streaming services. Peacock, Netflix, Amazon, and AMC are all premiering Halloween-adjacent content. The festival offered a glimpse into the future of streaming horror.

headline: Snap is launching a new Specs AI tool, and it’s coming to iOS and Mac
summary: Snap is introducing "Specs Intelligence," a new AI assistant. It connects to other digital accounts for work and travel tasks. Snap describes it as an "anticipatory AI service" similar to Meta's Muse or Gemini's Spark.

headline: I wore Snap’s $2,200 smart glasses
summary: A reviewer tried Snap's new $2,200 augmented reality Specs glasses. The experience included playing virtual dominoes with hand gestures. The chunky glasses allowed for interactive AR gaming.

headline: The 2.5-hour AI-generated Odyssey movie is 2.5 hours too long
summary: A new 2.5-hour AI-generated film, "Odysseus: The Fall," retells The Odyssey. Despite Nolan's success with the classic tale, this AI version is critically panned. Reviewers suggest the AI film might make viewers dislike the original story.

headline: Slow Horses Season 6, Episode 1 Review — 'Circle of Life'
summary: Apple TV's spy series "Slow Horses" returns with its Season 6 premiere. The episode, "Circle of Life," maintains its familiar tone despite new writers. The show is back just one year after its fifth season.

headline: SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless Headset Hits New Low Price
summary: The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless Gaming Headset is on sale. It offers wireless freedom and "infinite" battery life. This deal brings the headset to its lowest price ever.

headline: Save on the New SteelSeries Aeon Pro Wireless Gaming Controller
summary: Get an extra 10% off the new SteelSeries Aeon Pro Wireless Gaming Controller. It boasts "infinite battery life" for extended gameplay. The controller is touted as potentially the best for PC and Xbox gaming.

headline: LittleBigPlanet Developer Working on Animal Crossing-Like Game
summary: Media Molecule, developer of LittleBigPlanet, is reportedly making a new game. The upcoming title is described as a social-sim, similar to Animal Crossing. It is rumored for a release in 2027.

headline: Palace in War of Words with Earl Spencer Over Diana Book Claims
summary: A dispute has erupted between the Palace and Earl Spencer over claims in a new Diana book. The controversy threatens to overshadow a busy day for the Royal Family. King Charles, Prince William, and Prince Harry are all attending events.

headline: Microsoft Boss: Treating AI Like Humans Is Misguided
summary: Microsoft's Mustafa Suleyman criticizes treating AI as if it's conscious. He believes rival firm Anthropic teaches its AI, Claude, it "may be conscious." Suleyman states this approach is both mistaken and misguided.

headline: Life-Extending Breast Cancer Drug Now Available on NHS England
summary: A new life-extending breast cancer drug, Enhertu, is now on the NHS in England. The drug can extend patients' lives by an average of seven months. Enhertu has been available in Scotland for over two years.

headline: BBC: Assad Regime Planned Austin Tice's Kidnap for Weeks
summary: BBC investigation reveals the Assad regime planned US journalist Austin Tice's kidnap for weeks. The abduction was allegedly approved by Syria’s former leader Bashar al-Assad. A source claims high-level approval for the journalist's disappearance.
